sloka: प्रच्छादनार्थम् भावस्य न भक्षयति संस्पृशन् ।तस्मिन् एव ततः काले वैदेही शुभलोचना ॥३-४२-३०॥
transliteration: pracchādanārtham bhāvasya na bhakṣayati saṁspṛśan ।tasmin eva tataḥ kāle vaidehī śubhalocanā ॥3-42-30॥

translations.english: In the mean time Sita who, with her auspicious looks, was busy plucking flowers drew near the trees.
